title: Verify the Taskfold reliability proposal's assumptions

tasks.title: Spike: does Accordion see pi-auth-plus's corrected usage under pig

report.outcome: Under pig with pi-auth-plus 0.5.5 (55baab6), assistant usage is neither de-duplicated nor recounted: a later extension's message_end and the persisted message both show cacheWrite == input. The token bus does work: pi-auth-plus:v1:tokens:context reported 7,397 tokens with source "tokenizer" where Pi counted 8,413.
decisions: Accordion de-duplicates cacheWrite itself — the pi-auth-plus correction never runs under pig
Use the token bus as the recount source: k = report.tokens / Accordion's unfolded estimate of the same messages, when source is tokenizer or count-endpoint
open: pi-auth-plus bug to report: under pig, physicalHooksAvailable() is true but usage correction never applies

tasks.title: Spike: PiG delivers tool_call block and sendUserMessage followUp to Node extensions

report.outcome: Both work under PiG for Node extensions: tool_call returning {block:true, reason} turned the call into an error tool result whose content is exactly the reason, and DeepSeek retried as told; sendUserMessage(…, {deliverAs:"followUp"}) from agent_end started a new run, and the follow-up is persisted as a user message.
decisions: Gate uses tool_call {block, reason}; reason must carry the full fix because it is the only text the model sees
Follow-up uses sendUserMessage followUp from agent_end; it shows as a user message, so its text must read as an Accordion notice

tasks.title: Spike: the HUD can ride the outgoing wire without being persisted

report.outcome: A context-hook append to the last outgoing message reaches the model (DeepSeek quoted the injected line verbatim) and is not persisted: the stored user message lacks it in both probe sessions.
decisions: Accordion appends the HUD inside its own context handler, after ingesting messages into Truth and after serializing the folded wire, so Truth never sees it and no hook ordering matters
open: Cache cost of the moving HUD (the previous last message loses its HUD next request) not measured; expected to re-bill only the tail

tasks.title: Spike: keel-lite's planner can be extracted as a reusable function

report.outcome: keel-lite's ladder is a private method that reads instance state, so a clean extraction is a refactor; composition works without touching the ladder. keel-note already wraps an unmodified KeelLiteConductor on a proxy host, and keel-lite's eligibility already skips every grouped block, so Taskfold's records are never touched.
decisions: Reuse by composition, not extraction: Taskfold owns an unmodified KeelLiteConductor on a proxy host, like keel-note — plan() depends on instance state (decisions, prune, R0 re-assertion), so extracting it means a refactor of keel-lite
Taskfold forwards host events to the inner keel only after its own epoch settles, with the same HIGH/LOW band — keel then acts only when the task-record epoch left the context above HIGH
Add a keel-lite option that turns R7 off (groupChunkSteps is validated ≥ 1 today) — floor groups would cut across future task spans
open: keel-lite's roots (AGENT_BRIEFING.md, spec_*.md) are SlopCode-specific; harmless for Taskfold but the floor should set rootSpecPaths: 0

tasks.title: Spike: Truth lets a record group cover floor-folded blocks

report.outcome: A real-Truth test (TestHost) showed it works: auto fold and replace on three blocks applied, a group over a range containing them applied (live 5,745 → 4,112 after the floor → 1,934 after the group), and ungrouping restored the floor's fold and replace intact.
decisions: Fix in slice 3: Taskfold's unit() counts a member's current cost (folded ? foldedTokens : tokens), not only for its own groups — today it would overstate savings over floor-folded blocks and stop an epoch too early

tasks.title: Record spike results in the draft

report.outcome: Draft revision 7 records all five spike results in a new §9a and adjusts §3 (bus recount with an anchor rule), §4 (floor by composition, R7-off option, unit() cost fix) and §9; probe scripts and logs are committed as evidence (2d0f5b1).
open: pi-auth-plus bug (usage correction never applies under pig) is not filed; it lives in another repository
HUD cache cost is not measured
